candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
I never said to sell Rio2 to buy uranium stocks.

And as it happens, 2 years ago, I turned positive on this stock. I was also bullish gold, if cautiously so.

I can understand feeling left out if you decided to sell after reading my original take on the company before gold's big
